remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: Title as above" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert . . . May 1959." Pictured in 1930 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 35. "Glorieta" refers to a grove of cottonwood trees northeast of the Taos Pueblo. My gratitude to James C. Moore for identifying this location on the Taos Reservation. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
